svg.text: swift run OutputRepairDemo
== OutputRepairKit demo ==
--- 1. converge: a model that fixes its JSON once told exactly what is wrong ---
attempts: 3 repairs: 2
decoded: WeatherReport(city: "Delhi", tempC: 41, condition: "Sunny")
issues seen per failed attempt:
attempt 1: 2 issue(s) -> [tempC, condition]
attempt 2: 1 issue(s) -> [tempC]
the repair prompt the loop sent after attempt 1:
| Report Delhi's current weather as JSON with keys city, tempC, condition.
| Your previous reply was rejected. It was:
| {"city": "Delhi"}
| Fix exactly these 2 problem(s):
| 1. tempC: missing or not an integer (expected integer)
| 2. condition: missing or empty (expected non-empty string)
| Return only the corrected output, with no explanation.
--- 2. exhaust: a model that never fixes it, stopped by the attempt budget ---
gave up: Output still invalid after 4 attempt(s); 2 unresolved issue(s) on the final attempt.
--- 3. producer failure: the model call itself throws, surfaced verbatim ---
gave up: Producer failed on attempt 1: simulated 503 from provider
--- 4. stats: the loop actor accumulates health signal across all three runs ---
totalRuns: 3 succeeded: 1 exhausted: 1 producerFailures: 1
totalRepairs across finished runs: 5
--- 5. audit trail: every attempt, rejection, repair, and outcome recorded ---
21 events -> exhausted: 1, invalid: 6, produced: 7, producerFailed: 1, repairScheduled: 5, validated: 1
--- 6. backoff: an exponential, capped, deterministic repair schedule ---
